description: Source code for DRM utility functions in Android, including factory creation, status conversion, logging, and DRM plugin management.

classes.name: LogBuffer
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe buffer of DRM log messages.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates and initializes a DRM HAL object, checking its status.

methods.name: MakeHidlFactories
methods.description: Populates factory instances supporting a specific UUID for different HIDL versions.

methods.name: toHidlVec
methods.description: Converts raw data pointer to HIDL vector.

methods.name: toHidlArray16
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte array pointer to HIDL array.

methods.name: MakeDrmPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM plugin instance from a factory and UUID.

methods.name: MakeCryptoPlugin
methods.description: Creates a crypto plugin instance from a factory, UUID, and init data.

methods.name: UseDrmService
methods.description: Checks if the DRM service should be used based on system property.

methods.name: MakeDrm
methods.description: Creates a DRM object with a specified frontend.

methods.name: MakeDrmFactories
methods.description: Retrieves available HIDL DRM factories supporting a specific UUID.

methods.name: MakeDrmPlugins
methods.description: Creates DRM plugin instances for a given UUID and app package name.

methods.name: MakeCryptoFactories
methods.description: Retrieves available crypto factories supporting a specific UUID.

methods.name: MakeCryptoPlugins
methods.description: Creates crypto plugin instances for a given UUID and init data.

methods.name: GetExceptionMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed exception message including logs.

methods.name: LogBuffer::addLog
methods.description: Adds a log message to the buffer, maintaining max capacity.

methods.name: LogBuffer::getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves current logs from the buffer.

methods.name: statusAidlToDrmStatus
methods.description: Converts AIDL scoped status to DRM status.
